explanation: A title that shows respect and reverence for God, the almighty Creator.
The identification or designation of God, expressing his character and attributes.
The spiritual realm where God dwells and reigns, often associated with the place of divine presence.
The physical world we live in, including landmasses and all life upon them.
An image used to illustrate the protection and safety that God gives his people.
A snare or device for catching, here used metaphorically to represent dangers or difficulties people face.
To shatter or destroy, here used to describe how God helps his people escape from traps and dangers.
Support, guidance, or assistance that God gives his people in their distress and trials.
